name: thor-computer-app
description: Local development, seeding and test commands. Everything here targets the Firebase emulators and the demo-thor project; nothing deploys.

scripts.setup: npm ci --prefix functions && npm ci --prefix web && npm ci --prefix tests && bash scripts/prepare-local.sh
scripts.emulators: bash scripts/prepare-local.sh && bash scripts/local-env.sh firebase emulators:start --project demo-thor
scripts.test:rules: bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:rules
scripts.test:smoke: bash scripts/prepare-local.sh && bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:smoke
scripts.test:web: npm --prefix web run typecheck && npm --prefix web run build
scripts.test: npm run test:functions && npm run test:rules && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:smoke:mfa && npm run test:wp && npm run test:browser && npm run test:web && npm run lint:php
scripts.test:browser: bash scripts/prepare-local.sh && bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:browser
scripts.test:smoke:mfa: bash scripts/prepare-local.sh && REQUIRE_ADMIN_MFA=true bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:smoke:mfa && REQUIRE_ADMIN_MFA=false bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:smoke:mfa && REQUIRE_ADMIN_MFA=warn bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:smoke:mfa
scripts.test:wp: bash scripts/prepare-local.sh && bash scripts/local-env.sh npm --prefix tests run test:wp
